_comment: Multi-angle 360 base (KAN-16 follow-on): the fixed part of backend/workflows/full_pipeline_360.json — loaders + extend/outpaint stage + front (0deg) save + shared LoRA/encode. The angle branches are appended per-request in Python (job_handlers.build_plate_angles), so angle count/prompts and the double-ref toggle are code, not map keys. image_node = source plate; expand_* = ImagePadForOutpaint; front_output_node = the front SaveImage. Shared wiring targets referenced by the branch templater: clip=2, vae=3, angles_model=54, shared_ref_latent=18, extend KSampler=12. UNVALIDATED against a live ComfyUI.
